name: phantom Lifeboat (independent SPOF daemon)
description: phantGNOME independent lifeboat. A tiny mode-extension that is NOT the same object as the phantom-ui umbrella, loaded by the ExtensionManager from the phantom session mode independently of the umbrella's load state. It mounts an always-present anchor + a re-enable affordance so even a dead, disabled, or OUT_OF_DATE umbrella leaves a way back to a usable desktop. Realizes FUSION-FRAMEWORK.md section 9.2 / MODES.md section 3,5.9 / STRESS #4. See also the in-umbrella secondary Lifeboat affordance.
